info.name: Cablix ERP API
info.description: Current Cablix ERP APIs. Login and refresh automatically save the issued session variables.

request.description: Checks backend availability. No authentication required.
Logs in a platform or tenant user. The backend determines the account type.
Rotates the refresh token and automatically saves the new token pair.
Revokes the current refresh token and clears Postman session variables.
Requires a platform user with platform.dashboard.view permission.
Lists active and inactive subscription plans. Requires subscription.manage.
